positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Worked as part of an interdisciplinary team consisting of computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, and mechanical engineering majors developing in-house unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) for imaging outdoor scenes. The drone design will enable heterogeneous sensing, in-flight battery changing, and combination of multiple drones to enable improve sensing/compute/power performance. Platform utilizes several SBCs (Raspberry Pi, Jetson Nano) and their respective flight controller hat (Navio2, Pixhawk 4). The drones will be controlled with Ardupilot, mavros, ROS, APM planner, and Mission planner. 

Worked on predicting food readiness for everyday breakfast items such as eggs, bacon, and pancakes by training convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and long short-term memory networks (LSTMs) on RGB, infrared, and thermal data captured in-house. 

Worked on an algorithm that detects, tracks, and estimates density of slip lines on metal samples imaged using an optical microscope. Wrote custom MATLAB-based algorithm utilized several well known techniques including Hough Transforms, Cothen-Sutherland line clipping, and Kanade–Lucas–Tomasi feature tracking. 

Performed data annotation for a robotic grasp project by annotating 6,752 frames by labeling the type of grasp for each frame. Performed data annotation for a finger keypoint detection project for missing digits by annotating 550 frames and providing missing digit masks.

positions.title: Summer REU Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Worked on creating a data set that consists of unique features across metal samples imaged using an optical microscope. Wrote a custom MATLAB-based algorithm that utilized several well-known techniques including The Harris Corner Detector and Kanade–Lucas–Tomasi feature tracking. Developed a custom method to determine the uniqueness of these features. 
Worked on the designing and the training of a Siamese neural network used to identify and track these features across the data set.

publications.title: Slip Band Characterization with Microtensile Testing Using Digital Image Processing
